title: Monument of Torment
content:
# Monument of Torment

Internal ID: Spawner_CharredStone | Usage: Charred Twitcher (83%), Charred Warrior (17%) | Neutral to (x1): Pickaxe, ,, Chop | Resistant to (x0.5): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Immune to (x0): Fire, ,, Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

The Monument of Torment is a creature spawner found in the Ashlands.
The Monument can spawn Charred Warrior (17% chance) and Charred Twitcher (83% chance).
Spawned Charred have a 4% chance to be 1-star and a 0.2% chance to be 2-star.
The Monument activates when there is a player within 60 meters. The Monument attempts to spawn within 4 meters every 10 seconds.

## Drops

• Amount: 1 | Item: Grausten | Chance: 66%

• Amount: 1 | Item: Charred skull | Chance: 33%

## Notes

• Monuments of Torment can be found hidden inside large rock formations in the Ashlands. If trying to clear an area of all spawners, it is advisable to also clear the rocks.
• A rare Monument of Torment (Elite) spawning only 2-starred Charred can be found at Mysterious locations.
• During "The dead have been summoned." event, 3 Monuments of Torment spawn, with 20 seconds respawn timer if one is destroyed. They do not despawn after event ends.

Categorias: Building, Creature spawner
